title: "PaleHymnOutline"

output: html_document
---

Use this version — just the **kableExtra** table, no CSV.

```{r}


library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

outline <- data.frame(
  Part = 1:16,
  Title = c(
    "The Treaty Seal",
    "The Serathi Road",
    "Glentali Hears",
    "The Evacuation Road",
    "The War Leaves the Scourge",
    "The Weald War",
    "The Northern Forest Edge Defense",
    "Middle Vale Breaks",
    "The Verdant Taking",
    "The Black Coves",
    "Ashen Pale Defense",
    "The Buried Opens",
    "The War Turns",
    "The Crownless Flight",
    "The Queen Unfound",
    "The First Hymn"
  ),
  Summary = c(
    "Coral Pass blocks the sea route and accepts the Scourge land route.",
    "Goblins enter through the Shatterlands.",
    "Glentali sees smoke, refugees, and proof of goblin invasion.",
    "Glentali, RidgeFount, Ternhaven, Greyharbor Downs, and Salt-Willow respond.",
    "The goblin host divides: the Goblin King goes north through the Weald; the Crownless King goes east toward Middle Vale.",
    "The Goblin King fights through the Weald and against Cragwold resistance.",
    "NFE descends into the northern Weald fight and gets mauled.",
    "The Crownless King defeats Middle Vale.",
    "After Middle Vale, the Crownless King redirects or backtracks into Verdant Steppes.",
    "Pirate coves and hidden markets move captives, beasts, trolls, and forbidden cargo.",
    "The Goblin King reaches Ashen Pale; TorDwergs defend the Queen’s realm.",
    "Ashermire and Splintergrove release Grave-Bought, Ash-Rot beasts, predators, trolls, and buried monsters.",
    "Goblin King, TorDwergs, NFE, and Coral Pass are forced into the same fight against the horror.",
    "The Crownless King’s army fractures; he flees south toward Dusk Reed with loyalists, wealth, captives, and secrets.",
    "The Queen’s castle falls, empties, or is abandoned, but she is never found.",
    "Pale Hymn begins in Ashen Pale after the physical rot is defeated, contained, or lost."
  ),
  Purpose = c(
    "Coral Pass chooses survival; Oasis Scourge becomes the sacrifice.",
    "The betrayal begins under treaty cover.",
    "The Scourge realizes the Goblin King sent war.",
    "The Scourge buys time while the Shatterlands still fight.",
    "Two wars begin: the Goblin King’s tragic purpose and the Crownless King’s private ambition.",
    "The Goblin King loves the Weald and the Cragwolds, making this a painful betrayal rather than ordinary conquest.",
    "NFE tries to stop the Goblin King, but he bends east toward Ashen Pale.",
    "The Crownless King’s independent power, captains, reputation, and ambition grow.",
    "Captive-taking begins at scale; Verdant families are split.",
    "Coral Pass’s old anti-slaver war connects to the coming horror.",
    "Goblins and TorDwergs are still enemies; the war still looks conventional.",
    "The war changes from army conflict to rot catastrophe.",
    "The strange alliance forms, later mythologized by Pale Hymn writers.",
    "His corruption becomes one of Dusk Reed’s later roots.",
    "Her role and the rot’s origin remain mystical and unresolved.",
    "Public doctrine spreads order and equality; deepest circles preserve rot theology."
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)

outline %>%
  kbl(
    caption = "How the Pale Hymn Began — Revised Outline",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c("c", "l", "l", "l")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left",
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "0.6in", bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "2.0in", bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "4.4in") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "4.4in")


```
